source: scripts/scripts.js + scripts/aem.js (adobe/aem-boilerplate 1.3.0 vintage), read 2026-10-07 by C0 foundation
blockWrapper: decorateBlock adds .block + data-block-name, parent becomes div.<name>-wrapper, section gains .<name>-container
buttonizationNotes:
decorateButtons matches p a[href] only; the anchor must be alone in its

; anchors containing and URL-display links are skipped; the emphasis tag is REPLACED by the classed anchor
wrapTextNodes: a cell whose first child is not P/PRE/UL/OL/PICTURE/TABLE/BLOCKQUOTE/H1-6 (or a PICTURE followed by anything) is wrapped whole in one
sections: decorateSections: main > div -> .section[data-section-status]; default content wrapped in div.default-content-wrapper; section-metadata folded server-side (style -> classes)
fontsLoader: loadFonts() loads styles/fonts.css (eager when innerWidth >= 900 or sessionStorage fonts-loaded; always in loadLazy)
chrome: loadHeader/loadFooter build the header/footer blocks inside body > header / body > footer; the blocks fetch /nav and /footer (.plain.html) via loadFragment; metadata nav/footer override the path
lang: loadEager sets documentElement.lang = 'en' (stock; FR site -- cluster may not restructure loadEager)

navHeight.composition: lang strip 29px + header row 57px (measured on the gated prototype and on live)

capModel: module caps (DESIGN.json extensions.breakpoints); shell fluid; main > .section > div { max-width: var(--container-max) } with .full-bleed escape
lint: eslint airbnb-base (.eslintrc.js) + stylelint-config-standard (.stylelintrc.json); kebab-case classes and custom properties; lines <= 100
